description_en: Query the details of a content moderation job
description_zh: 查询媒体审核作业的详细信息
name: QueryMediaCensorJobDetail

parameters.help_en: The ID of the content moderation job. You can obtain the job ID from the response parameters of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91774.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 媒体审核作业ID。可以从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91774.html的返回参数中获取
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. The token of the next page is returned after you call this operation to query the results of a content moderation job for the first time
parameters.help_zh: 下一页标识，第一次提交时为空即可。下一页标识将在第一次查询后返回
parameters.name: next_page_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return on each page.

Default value: 30.

Valid values: 1 to 300
parameters.help_zh:
每页最大返回数。

默认：30
取值：1~300
parameters.name: maximum_page_size

MediaCensorJobDetail.description_en: The results of the content moderation job
MediaCensorJobDetail.description_zh: 媒体审核作业结果列表

Label.description_en:
Categorization of the detection result. Valid values:

normal: Normal content

spam: Spam

ad: Advertisement

politics: Political content

terrorism: Terrorism-related content

abuse: Abusive language

porn: Pornographic content

flood: Flooding (excessive repetitive content)

contraband: Contraband-related content

meaningless: Meaningless content

harmful: Harmful scenario (supports detection scenarios such as materialism and flaunting wealth, celebrity fandom promotion, negative emotions, and negative inducement)
Label.description_zh:
检测结果的分类。取值：

normal：正常文本

spam：含垃圾信息

ad：广告

politics：涉政

terrorism：暴恐
abuse：辱骂
porn：色情
flood：灌水
contraband：违禁
meaningless：无意义
harmful：不良场景（支持拜金炫富、追星应援、负面情绪、负面诱导等检测场景）

Suggestion.description_en:
Processing suggestion. Valid values:

pass: Pass

review: Review

block: Block
Suggestion.description_zh:
处理建议。可取值：

pass：通过。
review：人工重审。
block：拦截

PipelineId.description_en: The ID of the ApsaraVideo Media Processing (MPS) queue to which the content moderation job is submitted

State.description_en: The status of the job. Valid values:

Suggestion.description_en:
The overall result of the job. Valid values:

pass: The content passes the moderation.

review: The content needs to be manually reviewed again.

block: The content needs to be blocked.

If the moderation result of one type of the moderated content is review, the overall result is review. If the moderation result of one type of the moderated content is block, the overall result is block
Suggestion.description_zh:
作业整体审核结果。取值：

pass：通过
review：人工重审
block：拦截

任何一种类型的审核结果是review时，整体结果为review，任何一种类型的审核结果是block时，整体结果为block
